description:
A tiny male. A much larger female. A lasting physical connection.

In the triplewart seadevil, Cryptopsaras couesii, attachment can become permanent as tissues and blood vessels connect over time. The male remains identifiable and reproductive. Not all anglerfish do this.

Original AI-generated biological reconstruction; fusion is time-compressed. Synthetic narration; original sound.

Sources:
https://www.nature.com/articles/256038a0
https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aaz9445
https://doi.org/10.1098/rspb.2026.1268
